segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Provides insurance products and services to commercial, public, quasi-public, professional and individual customers, plus non-insurance warranty services through dealer F&I businesses.
segments.evidence: The Retail segment provides a broad range of insurance products and services to commercial, public and quasi-public, professional and individual insured customers, and non-insurance services and products through our automobile dealer services F&I businesses.

segments.name: Specialty Distribution
segments.description: Consists of programs, wholesale brokerage and specialty businesses providing niche solutions for hard-to-place risks to carriers, brokers and customers.
segments.evidence: The Specialty Distribution segment consists of our programs, wholesale brokerage and specialty businesses.

revenueModel.text: The company earns commissions and fees, primarily paid by insurance carriers and customers, for selling insurance products and providing related services as an agent or broker.
